title: Walking
description:
The picture shows the footprints of a man walking. The pacelength P is the distance between the rears of two consecutive footprints.

For men, the formula n/P = 140 gives an approximate relationship between n and P where:

n = number of steps per minute
P = pacelength in metres
imageAlt: Footprints of a man walking, with pacelength P marked as the distance between the rears of two consecutive footprints
